summary: Prudential plc furnished a Form 6-K on 2026-11-03 containing a UK MAR Article 19-style PDMR notification for CEO Anil Wadhwani. The filing discloses the acquisition of 1,836 ordinary shares of 5 pence each (ISIN GB0007099541) at HKD 93.75 per share on 2026-11-02 on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange, arising from dividends accruing to deferred share awards under the Annual Incentive Plan. No board recommendation, adviser, premium or ownership change is stated. This is a routine director/PDMR shareholding disclosure, not a special situation; no structural or regulatory-clock elements apply, and no deal-risk angle exists.
